title: FATAL: too many connections after traffic spike
root_cause: Pool size x replicas exceeded max_connections=100
resolution: Added PgBouncer, pool_size reduced to 5 per replica

title: OOMKilled in report-worker during month-end export
root_cause: Export loaded whole table into memory
resolution: Streamed export in 10k-row batches; limit raised to 1Gi

title: /var full on web-03 from nginx access logs
root_cause: logrotate disabled by a config change
resolution: Restored logrotate daily with 7-day retention; alert at 85%

title: 502 on checkout after deploy v2.14.0
root_cause: New version listened on port 8081 instead of 8080
resolution: Rolled back; added port check to CI

title: api.shopnest.in certificate expired on a Sunday
root_cause: cert-manager HTTP-01 challenge blocked by new WAF rule
resolution: Allowed /.well-known/acme-challenge in WAF; expiry alerts added

title: auth-gateway CrashLoopBackOff after secret rotation
root_cause: Secret key name changed, env var missing

title: KeyError 'price' on legacy orders
root_cause: Orders created before 2024 have no price field

title: ENOTFOUND redis.internal in staging
root_cause: CoreDNS pods evicted under node disk pressure
resolution: Resource requests for CoreDNS; disk alerts

title: 429 from payments provider during flash sale
resolution: Exponential backoff with jitter; outbound queue

title: All mobile logins failing with 401
root_cause: JWT signing key rotated without overlap period

title: p99 9s on search-api
resolution: Index added; query plan review in CI

title: ImagePullBackOff for catalog-api v3.2.1
root_cause: Image tag pushed to wrong registry project
resolution: CI verifies image exists before deploy
